quests.instruction: Which vehicle travels along the steel tracks click-clacking carrying hundreds?
quests.question: Train
quests.explanation: Take your time and look closely. You'll get it right next time!
quests.funFact: Trains travel on long metal tracks and can carry hundreds of people all at once!

quests.instruction: Which vehicle travels along the sky flying high like a giant metal bird?
quests.question: Airplane
quests.explanation: Take your time and look closely. You'll get it right next time!
quests.funFact: Airplanes have big wings and fly high up above the clouds just like giant birds!

quests.instruction: Which vehicle travels along the cool blue lake floating with sails up?
quests.question: Boat
quests.explanation: Take your time and look closely. You'll get it right next time!
quests.funFact: Boats float on water and some even use the invisible wind to sail across the sea!
